item_name: Rothco Triple Retention Tactical Duty Belt
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Triple Retention Tactical Duty Belt combines strength and functionality, making it a reliable choice for on-the-job use. The 2-inch-wide belt is made with durable poly webbing and a plastic-bonded sandwich design for added rigidity, ensuring it holds its shape under heavy loads. The triple retention buckle and hook & loop closure provide a secure fit, while the inner hook & loop feature allows seamless compatibility with inner duty belts for enhanced stability.
